dialogues.speaker: VIP Room Guard
dialogues.text: Apologies, but this is the VIP Lounge. It is not open to ordinary guests...

dialogues.speaker: VIP Room Guard
dialogues.text: If you do not have a <color=#00E1FFFF>VIP Pass</color>, I'm afraid you cannot enter.

dialogues.speaker: VIP Room Guard
dialogues.text: Ah, this is indeed a... Hmm. How strange. Has this pass ever been granted to a human?

dialogues.speaker: VIP Room Guard
dialogues.text: #Still, my job is to verify and stand guard, nothing more. Please, step inside, good {M#Sir} {F#Madam}.

dialogues.speaker: VIP Room Guard
dialogues.text: If you should need anything at all, do not hesitate to contact the waiting staff in the lounge.
